title.en: stacey kent at freespace, west kowloon.
title.de: stacey kent im freespace, west kowloon.

line.en: two performances by stacey kent at freespace on tuesday 17 november, part of the cathay westk jazz fest. check the ticket listing for the times before you go.
line.de: zwei auftritte von stacey kent im freespace am dienstag 17. november, Teil des cathay westk jazz fest. die zeiten stehen auf der ticketseite, bitte vorher prüfen.
line.tr: 17 kasım salı günü freespace'te stacey kent'in iki konseri, cathay westk jazz fest kapsamında. gitmeden önce saatleri bilet sayfasından kontrol et.

sparks.why: Stacey Kent, two performances at Freespace on 17.11 within the Cathay WestK Jazz Fest 2026, per festival coverage in The Standard and Time Out Hong Kong. Set times not confirmed; 19:30 is a suggestion.
